Meanwhile the Strait of Hormuz is closed and the cease fire deal is expiring. US, Isreal and Iran drama is keeping oil prices high which is leading to inflation expectations. BTC and Ethereum had inflows, while the Clarity Act gets delayed because the banks aren't happy with competition.
